# chadworks

> Websites and visibility, built with luxury-grade craft. Chad custom-builds fast, search-ready websites and helps clients choose how the site gets built (custom-coded, WordPress, ecommerce, or Shopify), then keeps them visible in classic search and AI assistants. Client results include a Pennsylvania criminal-defense firm appearing in Google's AI Overview and a Brooklyn psychologist named in AI answers.

## Websites

- [Websites](https://chadworks.co/websites/): The lane hub for everything about getting a site built.
- [Web Development](https://chadworks.co/web-development/): The technology behind a website: custom-built, fast, search-ready, and owned by the client. Funnels to four build options.
- [Web Design](https://chadworks.co/web-design/): The visual half of the same craft: design that makes a business read as credible at a glance.
- [Web Design Packages](https://chadworks.co/web-design-packages/): The three engagement postures, built on real numbers ($3,200 baseline, most land between $5,000 and $10,000).
- [WordPress](https://chadworks.co/wordpress/): WordPress builds and real maintenance ($550 every 6 months).
- [Custom-Coded Static](https://chadworks.co/custom-coded-static/): Custom-coded static sites, the fastest and most durable build route. This site is one.
- [Ecommerce](https://chadworks.co/ecommerce/): The full store conversation: WooCommerce versus Shopify, costs on the table.
- [Shopify](https://chadworks.co/shopify/): Custom Shopify stores by someone who has run the platform at multi-million dollar volume.

## Visibility

- [Visibility](https://chadworks.co/visibility/): The lane hub: being found and chosen in Google, in AI assistants, and in the inbox.
- [AI Visibility](https://chadworks.co/ai-viz/): The umbrella service, retained monthly: SEO, structured data, profiles, and answer-shaped pages that get businesses recommended by ChatGPT and Google's AI. Real precedent: a PA criminal-defense firm in Google's AI Overview, a Brooklyn psychologist named in AI answers.
- [AI Visibility Audit](https://chadworks.co/ai-visibility-audit/): The one-time measurement: a documented, scored read on standing in AI answers, classic search, schema, and profiles. Flat quote, no retainer inside.
- [SEO](https://chadworks.co/seo/): Classic SEO as the foundation layer of AI visibility. Page-one results in contested local markets.
- [Show Up on ChatGPT](https://chadworks.co/show-up-on-chatgpt/): The organic AI-visibility route: get your business named in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity answers by fixing crawlability, schema, and quotable content. Starts with the flat-quoted AI Visibility Audit (priced from $315/hr), not a fixed package. Cross-links the paid route.
- [Advertising on ChatGPT](https://chadworks.co/advertising-on-chatgpt/): Managed ChatGPT advertising for the sponsored slot at the bottom of an answer (free and Go tiers). Flat $675 a month management; ad spend separate at the $25-a-day OpenAI floor, billed directly to the client. Run from inside OpenAI's advertising beta. Most consumer and local categories eligible; financial, health, legal, and a flat-no list are blocked.
- [Digital Marketing](https://chadworks.co/digital-marketing/): Honest channel triage: which channels a business actually needs, with access to OpenAI's ChatGPT advertising beta.
- [Email Marketing](https://chadworks.co/email-marketing/): The channel you own: clean lists, real segments, restrained cadence. Mailchimp is free up to 500 contacts, and clients hear when free is all they need.

## Industry web design

- [Industry Web Design](https://chadworks.co/my-industry-specialties/): The industry index. Conversion-focused, server-rendered, schema-rich websites built around how one trade actually wins customers. Custom builds run $5,000 to $10,000, quoted up front.
- [Website Design for Septic Companies](https://chadworks.co/website-design-for-septic-services/): Septic service websites built to win the 11pm emergency call: fast on a phone, tap-to-call in the header, license and insurance up top, and a page for every town you cover.
- [Website Design for Foundation Repair Contractors](https://chadworks.co/website-design-for-foundation-repair/): Foundation repair websites built to win the basement-flood call: fast on a phone, engineer signoff and transferable warranty up top, a dedicated ranking page for every method, and a page for every town you cover.
- [Website Design for Tree Companies](https://chadworks.co/website-design-for-tree-companies/): Tree service websites built for the storm-damage call: emergency response, service-area pages, and real crew and crane-truck photography.
- [Website Design for Bands & Musicians](https://chadworks.co/website-design-for-bands-musicians/): Musician websites that carry tour dates, streaming and merch links, an EPK, and mailing-list capture, fast on a phone at a show.
- [Web Design for Authors](https://chadworks.co/web-design-for-authors/): Author websites built around book launches, retailer buy-links, a reader mailing list, and your backlist.
- [Music Industry Web Design](https://chadworks.co/music-industry-web-design/): Specialized design for labels, studios, managers, and producers: roster, discography, studio booking, and credibility.
- [Web Design for PA Preferred Members](https://chadworks.co/web-design-for-pa-preferred-members/): Web design for Pennsylvania-grown and Pennsylvania-made businesses: local-PA credibility, market and farm-stand info, and buy-local trust signals.

## Switch

- [Leave WordPress](https://chadworks.co/switch/leave-wordpress/): Rebuild a WordPress site that just sits there as fast, secure static pages on the same domain. Static hosting is $20 a month (about $10 less than a typical WordPress host), $10 for non-profits. Local-lead near Philadelphia, remote-friendly.
- [Gmail to Google Workspace](https://chadworks.co/switch/gmail-to-workspace/): Move off a free @gmail.com onto a branded you@yourdomain.com inside the same Gmail interface. Google Workspace runs under $10 a month per user; chadworks sets it up for a flat $300 (training and signature included), $25 per additional mailbox.
- [Squarespace to Static](https://chadworks.co/switch/squarespace-to-static/): Rebuild a rented Squarespace template as a fast custom static site you own outright, hosted for $20 a month ($10 non-profit), designed around your business instead of a shared theme.
- [Wix to Static](https://chadworks.co/switch/wix-to-static/): Leave a Wix site you can't export. Rebuilt as a fast custom static site you own and can take anywhere, hosted for $20 a month ($10 non-profit).
- [GoDaddy to Static](https://chadworks.co/switch/godaddy-to-static/): Trade the GoDaddy Website Builder for a real custom static site designed around your business. Keep your domain, drop the builder fee; hosting is $20 a month ($10 non-profit).

## Essays

- [Essays](https://chadworks.co/essays/): Published thinking on the web, business and the industry, written by Chad, not generated. The argument behind how chadworks works.
- [Chad Lewine: Worlds Combine](https://chadworks.co/essays/chad-lewine-worlds-combine/): Why the web design business and the music are one person's work under one purpose, not two careers kept apart. Chad ends the split he maintained between chadworks and his art, including the separate LinkedIn accounts, and explains how the song catalog now finds the clients.
- [Is Your Digital Marketing Agency Ripping You Off?](https://chadworks.co/essays/is-your-agency-ripping-you-off/): How the perpetual retainer works as an industry con, why most clients are dormant rather than active, and the real email thread with an agency billing a client $1,000 a month for what amounted to hosting. Includes Chad's own account of selling retainers at $125 a month and then retiring the service.

## About

- [About Chad](https://chadworks.co/about/): The person behind chadworks: one person who designs the site and writes the code, era by era from MySpace-taught HTML to clients named in AI answers.
- [Rates](https://chadworks.co/rates/): The real numbers with the math showing. Work bills at $315/hour; the smallest engagement is $3,200; most websites land between $5,000 and $10,000; WordPress care runs $550 every 6 months. Value-based, not the cheapest, deliberately.
- [FAQs](https://chadworks.co/faqs/): Straight answers in four groups: working together, what it costs, how the site gets built and owned, and getting found in classic search and AI assistants (with the real AI Overview and AI-answer precedents).
- [Contact](https://chadworks.co/contact/): Reach Chad directly. Email chad@chadworks.co or send the form (quick or detailed). It goes to the person who does the work, with a straight answer back within a day. Remote, based in Pennsylvania.
- Founder: Chad. Twenty years custom-building websites; designing since age 11.
- Track record: 50+ client engagements from 2019 through 2025, on top of the decade before them.
- Posture: value-based pricing ($315/hr, $3,200 baseline). Not the cheapest option, deliberately.
- Ownership: clients own their code and hosting outright. No platform lock-in, no hostage files.
- Accessibility: a baseline on every build, not an upgrade. Keyboard navigable, labeled for screen readers, readable contrast, and reduced-motion settings honored. Described as practice; no certified conformance standard is claimed.
- Privacy: a baseline on every build. Consent gates the tracking, so analytics only run after a visitor opts in, and no advertising or marketing pixels are used. Privacy policy, terms, and cookie controls ship with every site.
